title: Algebraic ring bridge for polynomial chart stalk flatness
statement: Under the polynomial chart hypotheses, flatness of the base stalk map and canonical polynomial fibre stalk map imply flatness of the chart stalk map together with locality of the chart stalk map.

proof.text: Apply the local flatness criterion to the stalk tower after the finite-presentation and canonical fibre-stalk identifications; the criterion yields flatness of the chart stalk map and its locality.

scheme stalk local criterion flat morphism fibre

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_chart_stalk_flat_comparison_reverse_ring_bridge
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T)
    [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ)
    (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e]
    (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f)
    (x : U.toScheme)
    (hbase : (f.stalkMap (U.ι x)).hom.Flat)
    (hfibre : (PolynomialChart.stalkMap f U n e he x).Flat) :
    (e.stalkMap x).hom.Flat ∧ IsLocalHom (e.stalkMap x).hom
